long_biography.plain_text:
When Aslan Khabliev acquired a century-old German electronics brand in 2019, the business needed capital and an operating reset. He became both owner and chief executive and kept production in Kronach. Personal funds financed the relaunch, while the company's balance sheet remained separate from his own wealth.

Khabliev had spent two decades in consumer electronics before the acquisition, moving from manufacturing operations into leadership of UMC and Skytec. That experience shaped a strategy centred on premium design and German production, while extending the business beyond televisions into audio and other high-end devices. He remains an active operator: the brand is his principal evidenced business asset, while its factories and revenues belong to the company rather than to him personally.
